newsitem.title: UK: Capital Corp reiterates rejection of LCI bid.
newsitem.headline: Capital Corp reiterates rejection of LCI bid.

text.p: British gaming company Capital Corp on Thursday reiterated its rejection of London Clubs International Plc's hostile 181 million stg bid, arguing that the offer undervalued the firm.
"Shareholders should not allow London Clubs to buy tomorrow's success at yesterday's price," the company said in a statement responding to London Clubs' offer document.
London Clubs launched its stock offer last month, saying its offer was generous and claiming that Capital had failed to delivery shareholder value.
But Capital defended its record, noting that since it came to the market in 1993 its share price had risen to more than 200p from 90p.
Capital said it would send its full response to shareholders by March 18.
Capital shares were unchanged at 203p by 1100 GMT, while London Clubs firmed 1.5p to 388.5.
